summary: Members can rename an item on the selected browser board. The mounted board visit owns drafts, pending labels and failed requests by item ID. The preview-only PUT resolves the current session and checks the write role and catalog grants in the same transaction as store::rename_item_at_revision.
evidence: browser_member_recovers_selected_name passed in headless Chromium. On board 201, single-click focused item 61; F2, typing and Escape canceled it. Keyboard activation and unchanged Enter also sent no PUT. Double-clicking Ink, replacing it with three spaces and clicking Sketch sent one PUT for 201/61 at revision 1 (422). Focus stayed on Sketch, Ink returned, and the board offered Retry change and Dismiss.

Reopening from Ink and canceling preserved the failure. Retry issued one selected GET (200, edit) then one identical PUT (422). Dismiss sent nothing. With item 61 locked, one Enter projected the raw padded ' Coral ' in display mode with no editor or failure; a fresh connection still read Ink/1. Releasing the lock returned item 61 Coral/2 (200). Back to boards and reopening 201 showed Sketch then Coral with no replay.

browser_demoted_viewer_cannot_rename passed. Demoting the editing Member before Enter yielded one PUT (403) followed by one selected GET (200, read). The page reported denial, showed Sketch and Ink and offered no write retry. Reopening as that Viewer and attempting pointer and keyboard entry produced no editor or write. No additional login occurred.

At checkpoints fresh connections compared the sole original session and account privately, the account role, closed-workspace membership and exact subscriptions. Ordered IDs, titles and revisions on 201 (73, 61), 202 (62 Outline/1) and the unchanged direct target (42, 17, both Review/1) matched expectations, including during the pending save.

preview_selected_rename_requires_current_access passed: a valid selected PUT returned 401 for absent and revoked bearers, 403 after removing only workspace membership, 403 for the legacy target without catalog metadata and 404 for the sibling board's item. Ordinary and navigation-only hosts returned 404 for the selected PUT; direct PUT to 201 still returned 404 on the preview. Denials returned empty bodies and fresh reads found no mutations.

All eight browser_preview cases passed serially in isolated profiles and schemas. All ten loopback_board_access cases passed. cargo test --locked --workspace passed 25 portable tests using the separate browser-packets target; cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed. The worker shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs before execution; Node runner regressions remain unverified here.

The comparison uses the earlier recorded cell and parent behavior, not a fresh end-to-end reference browser run. Durable drafts/failures, concurrent edit queues, successful retry after a transient fault, touch entry, multi-tab/live refresh and full-grid parity remain open.
